## European Cups

### ALBA Berlin narrowly lose EuroCup thriller to Castors Braine

ALBA Berlin's women's basketball team suffered a heartbreaking 81-82 defeat to Castors Braine in the EuroCup. Despite a strong performance, particularly on offense, the Berliners were unable to capitalize on their efforts and fell short in the end. The game was a closely contested affair, with both teams trading baskets throughout. ALBA Berlin led by as many as 25-23 in the first quarter, but Castors Braine fought back to take a 43-46 lead at halftime. The Berliners regained the lead in the third quarter, but Castors Braine again fought back to tie the game at 63-63. The home team then took a 78-70 lead, but ALBA Berlin managed to close the gap to just one point before ultimately falling short. The loss means that ALBA Berlin's chances of advancing to the EuroCup playoffs are now slim.

### Noah Eklou to Compete in adidas NextGen EuroLeague 2026/27

Noah Eklou, a 17-year-old player from the Basketball Löwen, will participate in the adidas NextGen EuroLeague 2026/27. He will play as a guest player for the U18 team of Veolia Towers Hamburg at the tournament in Vienna. Eklou will have the opportunity to gain international tournament experience. In the current season, he has played for both the Löwen and the SG Braunschweig in the Regionalliga, and has also appeared in two easyCredit BBL games, scoring his first BBL points in a game against Chemnitz. Eklou is excited about the challenge and sees it as a chance to prove himself and measure up against other international players. The adidas NextGen EuroLeague 2026/27 features 40 U18 teams from 15 countries competing for the continental junior title.

Sources:

- [Basketball Loewen Braunschweig: Noah Eklou ist beim adidas NextGen EuroLeague 2026/27 dabei!](https://www.basketball-loewen.de/noah-eklou-ist-beim-adidas-nextgen-euroleague-2026-27-dabei)

## Around the League

### Bamberg Baskets Support International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women

The Bamberg Baskets, along with their partner UN Women Deutschland e.V., are observing the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women, also known as Orange Day. The team will wear orange jerseys in their upcoming home game against the VITAMINAQUA Baskets Jena on Sunday. The Bamberg Baskets and Freak City Bamberg e.V. are using this opportunity to raise awareness about the importance of this issue and to promote a culture of zero tolerance for violence against women. The team emphasizes that violence against women and girls is a widespread problem that affects all aspects of life, including at home, in the workplace, online, and in schools. They encourage everyone to take action against this issue and to respect the boundaries and dignity of women and girls.

Sources:

- [Bamberg Baskets: Heute ist ORANGE DAY! | Bamberg Baskets](https://www.bamberg.basketball/news/heute-ist-orange-day)

### Bonn's Telekom Baskets Offer 20% Discount on Away Tickets

The Telekom Baskets Bonn have announced a 20% discount on away tickets for their fans, in response to the recent discussion about ticket prices for visiting fans in the easyCredit Basketball Bundesliga. The discount is available for fans who order tickets through their respective fan clubs, as part of the allocated guest ticket quota. According to Baskets' business manager Simon Pallmann, the team hopes that this move will contribute to a more vibrant fan culture in German basketball, where both home and away fans can come together to create a unique atmosphere. The Telekom Baskets Bonn believe that this initiative will benefit all parties involved, including the clubs, fan groups, and the sport as a whole.

Sources:

### Alba Berlin Offers 20% Discount on Merchandise During Yellow Days

Alba Berlin is hosting its Yellow Days from November 25 to 29, 2026. During this period, fans can get a 20% discount on all merchandise items in the team's online shop. The offer is applicable on all items except those that are already discounted, jerseys, and gift cards. This is a great opportunity for fans to show their support for the team and get their favorite items at a discounted price. Whether it's for themselves or as a gift for friends and family, fans can take advantage of this offer to represent Alba Berlin in their daily lives.
